intro.title: Comfortable amenities amid nature
intro.body1: We're located in a peaceful cottage area by the Elbe river, offering a fully equipped, insulated brick cottage for comfortable stays. The cottage has a 3-room layout. The bedroom has a 160×200 cm double bed, and the small room has bunk beds (90×200 cm). If needed, the living-room sofa can also be used for sleeping.
intro.body2: The cottage has a fully equipped kitchen with a fridge, freezer, dishwasher, hob, oven, microwave, coffee machine and wine fridge. For heating comfort there's an air-conditioning unit, underfloor heating throughout, an electric heater in the bedroom, and a wood-burning stove. Our own water treatment system ensures drinking water of the highest quality.
